text.autoconfig.simplemobs.title: Simple Mobs
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.howler: Hollow Howler Ritual

Blowing a goat horn at the Howler figure
summons the Hollow Howler. Off: the ritual
does nothing; the mob and its spawn egg stay.
Default: on.
Howler Ritual: Max Light

Highest light (block and sky light, like
monster spawns) at the figure's skull for
the ritual to start and keep running.
Default: 7. Range: 0–15.
Howler Sculk Trail

The Hollow Howler turns the ground it walks
on into sculk, one block every 3 s (needs
the mobGriefing game rule).
Default: on.
Howler Sculk Trail: Max Blocks

At most this many sculk blocks of trail per
Hollow Howler.
Default: 25. Range: 0–200.
Sculk Around the Summoning

When the Hollow Howler appears, the ground
around the figure (5 x 5) turns into sculk
(needs the mobGriefing game rule).
Default: on.
Howler Sculk Jaws

From phase 2 the Hollow Howler spits sculk
jaws under the players it hunts.
Default: on.
Howler Darkness Pulse

In its rage phase the Hollow Howler gives
hunted players nearby Darkness on a
heartbeat, like the Warden.
Default: on.
Darkness Pulse Interval (Ticks)

Ticks between two Darkness pulses
(20 ticks = 1 s).
Default: 120 (6 s). Range: 20–1200.
Darkness Pulse Length (Ticks)

How long the Darkness of one pulse lasts,
in ticks.
Default: 260 (13 s). Range: 20–1200.
Darkness Pulse Radius

Hunted players within this many blocks get
the Darkness.
Default: 20. Range: 4–64.
Howler Health

Maximum health of a newly spawned Hollow
Howler (the Warden has 500).
Default: 600. Range: 20–10000.
Howler Attack Damage

Melee damage of a newly spawned Hollow
Howler (the Warden deals 30).
Default: 34. Range: 1–500.
Howler Size (%)

Size of a newly spawned Hollow Howler in
percent, hit box and model together.
Default: 130. Range: 50–300.
Howler Jaws: Max at Once

At most this many sculk jaws of one Hollow
Howler at once.
Default: 6. Range: 1–30.
Howler Jaws: Interval (Ticks)

Ticks between two new sculk jaws.
Default: 100 (5 s). Range: 20–1200.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.minibo:
Boss bars with phase notches for the Hollow
Howler, Dread, Blighted and Abyssal Wither,
Void Runner and Brimguard.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.bossBa:
A boss bar shows for players within this
many blocks of its boss.
Default: 48. Range: 8–256.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.howler: Idle Howler Despawn (Minutes)

A Hollow Howler without a target vanishes
after this many minutes without a player
within 64 blocks.
Default: 10. Range: 1–1440.
Howler Ritual Dimensions

Dimensions where the ritual works, one id
per line (e.g. minecraft:overworld).
Default: minecraft:overworld.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.shellk:
Every newly generated End gateway gets four
Shellkers as guards.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.soulfi:
Soulfire Blazes spawn naturally in Soul
Sand Valleys.
Default: on.

Chance per roll (every 10 s per player in a
Soul Sand Valley) that a Soulfire Blaze
spawns.
Default: 0.2. Range: 0–1.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.dreadS:
The Dread figure (an iron T with an anvil
and a skeleton skull) summons the Dread.
Off: the figure does nothing; the mob and
its spawn egg stay.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.voidRu:
Three purpur blocks on End Stone with an Eye
of Ender, 4 Chorus Fruit and Dragon's Breath
summon the Void Runner.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.brimgu:
A 3 x 3 obsidian platform with 3 Shellker
Shells and a Nether Star summons the
Brimguard.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.bossRi: Boss Summoning Only in the End

The Void Runner and the Brimguard can only
be summoned in the End. Off: in every
dimension (never on Peaceful).
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.eggRit:
Mob Essence drops and the brood hollow that
turns it into spawn eggs. Off: no essence,
the hollow does nothing.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.essenc:
Chance that a monster killed by a player
drops Mob Essence; other mobs 40 % of it,
plus 1 % per Looting level.
Default: 0.05. Range: 0–1.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.hollow:
Hollow Watchers spawn naturally on the outer
End islands (more than 1000 blocks from the
center).
Default: on.

Chance per roll (every 30 s) on the outer
End islands that a Hollow Watcher appears.
Default: 0.04. Range: 0–1.

Seconds a player must stay in a Watcher
core biome without a break before the
forest chance applies.
Default: 120. Range: 10–3600.

Chance per roll (every 30 s) once a player
has stayed that long in a Watcher core
biome.
Default: 0.25. Range: 0–1.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.watche:
Half angle in degrees around your view
center in which the Hollow Watcher stands
still (at FOV 70, scaled with your FOV).
Default: 10. Range: 1–60.

Half angle in degrees around its eyes that
counts as a direct look: it does not freeze
but turns aggressive (not scaled).
Default: 4. Range: 0.5 up to the stare zone.

Farther away than this many blocks the
Hollow Watcher neither follows nor
teleports.
Default: 48. Range: 8–128.

Seconds between its teleports to a target
in range.
Default: 6. Range: 1–120.

Half angle of the slow zone, in which it
backs off slowly (at FOV 70, scaled).
Default: 25. Range: stare zone up to 80.

Half angle of the edge zone, in which it
backs off directly; beyond it, it stalks
freely (at FOV 70, scaled).
Default: 35. Range: slow zone up to 120.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.wither:
A Netherite Helmet (Abyssal: an Enderite
helmet) on the middle skull of the Wither
figure summons the Blighted Wither. Off: the
figure summons the Vanilla Wither.
Default: on.

In phase 3 the Blighted Wither wilts plants
and natural leaves (also needs the
mobGriefing game rule).
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.trickM:
On: the Trick Mirror has its recipe and
drop, shows in the creative tab and reveals
fakes. Off: none of that.
Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.trumpe:
Hold use to play notes; the pitch follows
your look angle. Off: the Trumpet does
nothing (the recipe stays).
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.mirror:
Mirror V: chance per hit that the attacker
takes the damage back instead of the bearer
taking more. Levels II to IV lie between
I and V.
Default: 0.5. Range: 0–1.

Mirror I: chance per hit that the attacker
takes the damage back.
Default: 0.2. Range: 0–1.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.wither:
How many times Vanilla's top rocket speed
the Wither Wings reach (1 = Vanilla).
Default: 2. Range: 1–8.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.nether:
How many times Vanilla's top rocket speed
the Nether Wings reach (1 = Vanilla).
Default: 4. Range: 1–8.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.endWin:
How many times Vanilla's top rocket speed
the End Wings reach (1 = Vanilla).
Default: 6. Range: 1–8.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.voidWi:
How many times Vanilla's top rocket speed
the Void Wings reach (1 = Vanilla).
Default: 8. Range: 1–8.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.strong:
Explosion power of Strong TNT (Vanilla TNT
4, a charged Creeper 6).
Default: 6. Range: 4–16.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.evilOm:
Master switch of the Evil chain: Evil Potion
brewing, Evil Omen, Evil Trials and Raids,
the Evil Vault. The Weathered Trials stay.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.voidCh:
Void Potion, Void Omen, Void Trials and the
Void Vault. Needs the Evil chain.
Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.spawne:
Chance that a Vanilla spawner mined with a
pickaxe (no Silk Touch) drops a Spawner
Fragment. 0 = never, 1 = always.
Default: 0.3. Range: 0–1.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.makesh:
A Makeshift Spawner works this many times
slower than a Vanilla spawner (1 = as fast).
Default: 3. Range: 1–10.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.trialS:
At most this many Weathered Trial Spawners
of one structure are active at once.
0 = no limit.
Default: 3. Range: 0–8.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.trialL:
Evil and Void Vaults give every item at most
once per opening and at least two kinds of
loot (resource, healing, magic, cosmetic).
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.evilHi:
Hits of Evil and Void mobs on players:
Wither (stage 2), slowing arrows (stage 3),
Darkness (stage 5).
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.voidMo:
Void mobs darken the air 6 blocks around
them; Void archers may teleport when hit.
Needs the Void chain.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.evilOn:
The Evil Omen also turns Vanilla Trial
Spawners (in Trial Chambers) evil. Off:
only Weathered Trials.
Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.weathe:
Weathered Trials generate in new chunks.
Off: no new ones; existing ones stay.
Default: on.

How many percent of the copper and tuff
blocks are missing in new Weathered Trials.
Default: 11. Range: 0–100.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.evilRa:
An Evil or Void Raid has one more wave and
leaves a Looter Chest after the victory.
Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.trimSt:
Overall factor of every armor trim bonus:
0 = off, 1 = as designed, 2 = double. With
SimpleBuilding it multiplies its own
per-bonus strengths.
Default: 1.0. Range: 0–2.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.zoneMo:
New monsters get status effects by the
Simple Resonance level of their spawn place
(never more health). Needs Simple Resonance.
Default: off.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.zoneMa:
At most this many zone effects per monster.
Default: 3. Range: 0–8.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.zoneSp:
Only monsters with these spawn reasons get
zone effects, one per line (natural, patrol,
chunk_generation, ...).
Default: natural, patrol, chunk_generation.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.zoneEf: Strength: Chance at Level 5

Chance that a new monster in a zone of
level 5 gets Strength; lower levels get less
(chance x (level / 5)^1.3).
Default: 0.35. Range: 0–1.
Strength: Max Level

Highest level (I to V) of Strength from the
zones; 0 = this effect is off.
Default: 3. Range: 0–5.
Speed: Chance at Level 5

Chance that a new monster in a zone of
level 5 gets Speed; lower levels get less
(chance x (level / 5)^1.3).
Default: 0.25. Range: 0–1.
Speed: Max Level

Highest level (I to V) of Speed from the
zones; 0 = this effect is off.
Default: 2. Range: 0–5.
Extra Hearts: Chance at Level 5

Chance that a new monster in a zone of
level 5 gets Absorption (extra hearts);
lower levels get less
(chance x (level / 5)^1.3).
Default: 0.3. Range: 0–1.
Extra Hearts: Max Level

Highest level (I to V) of Absorption from
the zones; 0 = this effect is off.
Default: 2. Range: 0–5.
Oozing: Chance at Level 5

Chance that a new monster in a zone of
level 5 gets Oozing; lower levels get less
(chance x (level / 5)^1.3).
Default: 0.2. Range: 0–1.
Oozing: Max Level

Highest level (I to V) of Oozing from the
zones; 0 = this effect is off.
Default: 1. Range: 0–5.
Infested: Chance at Level 5

Chance that a new monster in a zone of
level 5 gets Infested; lower levels get less
(chance x (level / 5)^1.3).
Default: 0.2. Range: 0–1.
Infested: Max Level

Highest level (I to V) of Infested from the
zones; 0 = this effect is off.
Default: 1. Range: 0–5.
Deflection: Chance at Level 5

Chance that a new monster in a zone of
level 5 gets Deflection; lower levels get
less (chance x (level / 5)^1.3).
Default: 0.25. Range: 0–1.
Deflection: Max Level

Highest level (I to V) of Deflection from
the zones; 0 = this effect is off.
Default: 5. Range: 0–5.
Volatile: Chance at Level 5

Chance that a new monster in a zone of
level 5 gets Volatile; lower levels get less
(chance x (level / 5)^1.3).
Default: 0.15. Range: 0–1.
Volatile: Max Level

Highest level (I to V) of Volatile from the
zones; 0 = this effect is off.
Default: 5. Range: 0–5.
Mirror: Chance at Level 5

Chance that a new monster in a zone of
level 5 gets Mirror; lower levels get less
(chance x (level / 5)^1.3).
Default: 0.1. Range: 0–1.
Mirror: Max Level

Highest level (I to V) of Mirror from the
zones; 0 = this effect is off.
Default: 5. Range: 0–5.
text.autoconfig.simplemobs.option.reduce:
Turns off the camera shake of the Hollow
Howler's shockwave and shriek.
Client-side. Default: off.
simplemobs.bossbar.title: %1$s - %2$s
jei.simplemobs.note.shellker_dress: Right-click a Shulker with the shell
jei.simplemobs.info.trick_mirror: No recipe. Hold use for 3 s to reveal up to 3 disguised fakes within 12 blocks (they glow for 2 s, 60 s cooldown). Only works when 'trickMirrorEnabled' is on in the Simple Mobs config (off by default); otherwise creative only.
jei.simplemobs.info.ender_parts: The Void Runner drops the Ender Heart, the Brimguard the Ender Gem - both End bosses you summon (see their spawn eggs).
effect.simplemobs.volatile.description: A hit on the bearer sets off a small explosion that hurts everyone nearby except the bearer. Breaks no blocks.
effect.simplemobs.deflection.description: 10 % per level (up to 50 %) to negate a hit completely.
effect.simplemobs.mirror.description: Every hit is a coin flip: the bearer takes 120 % to 200 % damage, or the attacker takes 20 % to 100 % back (never lethal).
effect.simplemobs.leech.description: Hits by the bearer heal the bearer by 5 % of the damage dealt per level (at most 25 %).
effect.simplemobs.frostbite.description: Hits by the bearer freeze the target (powder-snow frost) and slow it for 3 s (Slowness II from level III).
effect.simplemobs.magnetic.description: Pulls dropped items and experience orbs within 3 blocks per level towards the bearer (at most 12).
effect.simplemobs.tracer.description: Targets hit by the bearer glow for 5 s.
effect.simplemobs.decay.description: Hits by the bearer poison the target for longer with each level; undead wither instead, for half as long.
simplemobs.trials.turned.void: The trial falls into the void (Void Omen %s).
jei.simplemobs.trials.brew_note: Stage %s: the stage of the Ominous Bottle stays. 1-3 bottles below, the heart above, one heart per brew.
jei.simplemobs.trials.brew_fuel: Only in a Brewing Stand fuelled with Soulfire Powder: 1 powder = 20 soul charges, 1 charge per brew.
simplemobs.trials.raid_chest: The Evil Raid is won: a Looter Chest stands near the bell.
jei.simplemobs.trials.loot.head: %s draws from this pool per opening. Weights decide the share of each entry:
jei.simplemobs.trials.loot.tail: A book is enchanted at the level the table sets.
jei.simplemobs.trials.loot.tail.distinct: Every item comes at most once per opening and at least two kinds of loot (resource, healing, magic, cosmetic) come together (config trialLootNoRepeat); otherwise the draw is rolled again.
jei.simplemobs.trials.weathered.1: Weathered Trials are rare rooms underground: 9x9 (most), 13x13 (1 in 10) and a 19x19 cross (1 in 25).
jei.simplemobs.trials.weathered.2: The Weathered Trial Spawner works like the Vanilla one; the Weathered Vault gives its own loot.
jei.simplemobs.trials.weathered.3: A Trial Key from the spawner opens a normal vault, an Ominous Trial Key the ominous one (also Vanilla vaults).
jei.simplemobs.trials.weathered.4: Large rooms hold 2-4 spawners, 1 ominous and 3 normal vaults; the giant one up to 8 spawners, 2 ominous and 6 normal vaults.
jei.simplemobs.trials.evil_flow.1: 1. Brew an Evil Potion: Ominous Bottle + Nether Heart in a Brewing Stand fuelled with Soulfire Powder.
jei.simplemobs.trials.evil_flow.2: 2. Drink it: Evil Omen I-V (like Bad Omen, 100 minutes; it replaces Bad Omen).
jei.simplemobs.trials.evil_flow.3: 3. Enter a Weathered Trial: it turns evil. Mobs get more life (+10% per stage) and effects; the reward is the Evil Trial Key of that stage. In a village you start an Evil Raid instead.
jei.simplemobs.trials.evil_flow.4: 4. Turn a Weathered Vault into an Evil Vault (see Converting a vault) and open it with the key for the best loot.
jei.simplemobs.trials.void_flow.1: The Void chain is the Evil chain one tier up: Ender Heart instead of Nether Heart, netherite block instead of diamond block.
jei.simplemobs.trials.void_flow.2: It is off by default (config voidChain) until the Ender Heart has a source.
jei.simplemobs.trials.void_flow.3: Void Potion -> Void Omen -> Void Trial (stronger than Evil, one more effect step) -> Void Trial Key -> Void Vault.
jei.simplemobs.trials.void_flow.4: An Evil Vault becomes a Void Vault with a netherite block in the off hand and 5 strikes.
jei.simplemobs.trials.convert.1: Hold a diamond block in the off hand and strike a Weathered Vault 5 times with a hammer (an axe works without a hammer mod): it becomes an Evil Vault.
jei.simplemobs.trials.convert.2: Hold a netherite block in the off hand and strike an Evil Vault 5 times: it becomes a Void Vault (Void chain on).
jei.simplemobs.trials.convert.3: Only Weathered Vaults can be converted, never Vanilla vaults. The conversion cannot be undone.
jei.simplemobs.trials.convert.4: The Evil Vault takes only Evil Trial Keys (any stage, the loot follows the stage); the Void Vault only Void Trial Keys.
jei.simplemobs.info.spawner_parts: Mining a Vanilla spawner with a pickaxe (not with Silk Touch) leaves a Spawner Fragment with a 30 % chance (config spawnerFragmentChance). 9 Fragments make 1 Spawner Chunk, 9 Chunks make 1 Makeshift Spawner. It is empty until you use a spawn egg on it, and it works 3 times slower than a Vanilla spawner (config makeshiftSpawnerSlowdown).
jei.simplemobs.info.boss_summons: Summoned in the End. Void Runner: 3 purpur blocks on End Stone, an Eye of Ender and 4 Chorus Fruit on top, then Dragon's Breath on the top block. Brimguard: 3 x 3 obsidian, 3 Shellker Shells on the middle, then a Nether Star on it.
jei.simplemobs.info.brood: Brood hollow: a Purpur Block in a 3 x 3 Soul Sand ring with Soul Torches on the corners. Throw a Blank Egg, the essence of one mob and its catalyst onto it and light it with Flint and Steel: out comes the spawn egg. Essence drops rarely from mobs you kill.
simplemobs.guide.page.1.title: Simple Mobs
simplemobs.guide.page.1: New bosses and mobs with fair, announced attacks, their drops, the Blighted Wither and the Biome Brush.
simplemobs.guide.page.2.title: Hollow Howler
simplemobs.guide.page.2: A Deep Dark boss you summon yourself: build the figure, blow a goat horn near a sculk sensor in the dark, and it manifests within 5 seconds.
simplemobs.guide.page.3.title: Potion of Silence
simplemobs.guide.page.3: Warped Potion (Awkward Potion without SimpleLib) + Echo Core: 3:00 of Silence (redstone 8:00, splash and lingering as usual). Sculk sensors, Wardens and Howlers do not hear you, like wool.
simplemobs.guide.page.4.title: Shellker
simplemobs.guide.page.4: An End gateway guard: a Shulker in a bedrock-hard shell. Four of them sit beside every End gateway, disguised as bedrock, until you come close.
simplemobs.guide.page.5.title: High Gravity and the Shellker Helmet
simplemobs.guide.page.5: High Gravity pulls you down: jumps, Levitation and Elytra lift keep 10 % and falls hurt 50 % more per level (Feather Falling still helps). The Shellker Helmet makes you immune.
simplemobs.guide.page.6.title: Combat effects: Volatile, Deflection, Mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.6: Three status effects, levels I-V, for mobs and players:
simplemobs.guide.page.7.title: Combat effects: Volatile, Deflection, Mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.7: Volatile answers hits with a small explosion, Deflection negates hits, Mirror flips a coin between more damage for the bearer and damage back to the attacker.
simplemobs.guide.page.8.title: Danger zones: effects on new monsters
simplemobs.guide.page.8: With Simple Resonance installed and zoneMobsEnabled on, new monsters get status effects (never more health) by the danger level of their spawn place:
simplemobs.guide.page.9.title: Danger zones: effects on new monsters
simplemobs.guide.page.9: the farther from the world spawn and the more experienced the nearest player, the more likely and the stronger. Off by default until the client check.
simplemobs.guide.page.10.title: Armour trim abilities
simplemobs.guide.page.10: Armour trims do more than look good: every trim pattern and trim material gives its wearer a small ability (less damage of one kind, speed, luck, reach, air, experience). Simple Mobs applies them;
simplemobs.guide.page.11.title: Armour trim abilities
simplemobs.guide.page.11: they grow with the wearer's resonance from Simple Resonance (required). Cosmetic trim effects (glowing, placed templates) stay in Simple Trims.
simplemobs.guide.page.12.title: Soulfire Blaze
simplemobs.guide.page.12: A Blaze of soul fire, found rarely in Soul Sand Valleys. Shoots volleys of soul fireballs and drops the Soulfire Rod.
simplemobs.guide.page.13.title: Deceiver: cloak, disguise, mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.13: From Deceiver Cloth: a cloak that lets you take any mob's or player's shape, a particle-free invisibility potion and a mirror that sees through deceptions.
simplemobs.guide.page.14.title: Deceiver: cloak, disguise, mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.14: The Deceiver itself has double life, takes the hit box of the mob it imitates and can double its summons.
simplemobs.guide.page.15.title: Dread
simplemobs.guide.page.15: A fear mob you build yourself: a 2.6 block knight of rusted armor with soul flames in its empty helmet and a chain mace. Its Shivering aura makes your aim waver; bright light weakens it.
simplemobs.guide.page.16.title: Hollow Watcher
simplemobs.guide.page.16: A 4 block shadow with many eyes on the outer End islands. It moves only while nobody looks at it; a spyglass look freezes it. Unwatched it teleports behind you and grips you.
simplemobs.guide.page.17.title: Shivering aura, Calm Amulet and Focus
simplemobs.guide.page.17: Near a fear mob you shiver: your aim wavers. Shivering I to V by distance (V under 4 blocks) while it looks at you or is triggered.
simplemobs.guide.page.18.title: Shivering aura, Calm Amulet and Focus
simplemobs.guide.page.18: The Calm Amulet or the Potion of Focus makes you immune.
simplemobs.guide.page.19.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.20.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.20: put a Netherite Helmet on the middle skull of the Wither figure before the third skull and the Blighted Wither rises - 600 health,
simplemobs.guide.page.21.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.21: armor 8, three phases, and every special attack is announced before it
simplemobs.guide.page.22.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.22: hits. An Enderite Helmet calls the even stronger Abyssal Wither. Both drop a Nether Heart, the Abyssal Wither also a Red Nether Gem.
simplemobs.guide.page.23.title: Recipe book
simplemobs.guide.page.23: Every craftable item of the mod is in the recipe book: picking up one of its ingredients unlocks the recipe.
simplemobs.guide.page.24.title: Creative tabs
simplemobs.guide.page.24: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplemobs.guide.page.25.title: Wither Wings
simplemobs.guide.page.25: Four Elytra stages that raise only the top speed a strong firework rocket reaches: x2 Wither, x4 Nether, x6 End and x8 Void Wings. Normal rockets and gliding without a rocket stay Vanilla.
simplemobs.guide.page.26.title: Strong Gunpowder, Strong Rocket, Strong TNT
simplemobs.guide.page.26: Strong Gunpowder (3 gunpowder + 1 blaze powder -> 1) makes strong rockets (paper + 1 Strong Gunpowder -> 3, flight duration 4) and Strong TNT (like TNT with Strong Gunpowder, explosion
simplemobs.guide.page.27.title: Strong Gunpowder, Strong Rocket, Strong TNT
simplemobs.guide.page.27: power 6 instead of 4). Vanilla gunpowder, TNT and rockets stay untouched.
simplemobs.guide.page.28.title: Commands
simplemobs.guide.page.28: /simplemobs config shows and changes every option of config/simplemobs-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplemobs.guide.page.29.title: Commands
simplemobs.guide.page.29: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
simplemobs.guide.page.30.title: Commands
simplemobs.guide.page.30: /simpleclient simplemobs (list, get, set, reset, help) does the same for config/simplemobs-client.json on your own client.
simplemobs.guide.page.31.title: Weathered Trials
simplemobs.guide.page.31: Rare dungeon-like rooms underground with a Weathered Trial Spawner and Weathered Vaults - the Trial Chambers loop in verdigris copper, with their own loot.
simplemobs.guide.page.32.title: Evil Omen
simplemobs.guide.page.32: A stronger Bad Omen for Netherite-age players: brew the Evil Potion with a Nether Heart, drink it,
simplemobs.guide.page.33.title: Evil Omen
simplemobs.guide.page.33: turn a Weathered Trial or a village raid evil, win Evil Trial Keys and open an Evil Vault.
simplemobs.guide.page.34.title: Void chain
simplemobs.guide.page.34: The Evil chain one tier up - Void Potion, Void Omen, Void Trial, Void Vault - switched off by default until the Ender Heart has a source.
simplemobs.guide.page.35.title: Trials: limits, hits and switches
simplemobs.guide.page.35: What the Weathered Trials and the Evil Omen add on top of Vanilla, and every switch that turns it off.
simplemobs.guide.page.36.title: Void Runner
simplemobs.guide.page.36: An End boss you summon: a slim 1.9 block fencer with blades along its forearms and a long scarf. No magic - it is very fast, steps aside and is hard to hit. Drops the Ender Heart.
simplemobs.guide.page.37.title: Brimguard
simplemobs.guide.page.37: An End boss you summon: a squat 1.5 block figure under a wide bedrock sombrero. It cannot be hit from above - the brim catches everything that comes in too steeply. Drops the Ender Gem.
simplemobs.guide.page.38.title: Brood hollow
simplemobs.guide.page.38: Spawn eggs from mob essence, in the world: no block, no screen. A ring of soul sand, a purpur hollow, soul torches - throw in the offerings and light it.
